parsed_output.analysis: The specification requires: human driving is a simple state, autonomous is a sub-machine with sub-states, power-on leads to human driving, front_distance >10 moves to autonomous, human steering cmd / brake pressed moves back to human driving when in the autonomous final condition, and power-off moves to a final state. The PlantUML model starts in HumanDriving without a Power On label, adds a Power On transition from HumanDriving to Autonomous, creates an extra Front Distance <=10 entry into AutonomousIdle, returns to HumanDriving from AutonomousActive instead of from the autonomous final condition, and places AutonomousFinal as a top-level state reachable only from HumanDriving on Power Off. These diverge from the stated requirements.

issues.reason: Spec 3 says when power on the system turns into human driving mode. The model shows an unlabeled start into HumanDriving and a Power On transition leaving HumanDriving to Autonomous, reversing the required direction.
issues.where: [*] --> HumanDriving and HumanDriving --> Autonomous : Power On

issues.reason: Spec 5 says when power off it will transit to final state. The model only permits Power Off from HumanDriving to AutonomousFinal, not from the autonomous operational states where power-off would be expected, and the final state is not shown as part of the autonomous sub-machine.

issues.issue: Human steering / brake return originates from the wrong autonomous sub-state
issues.reason: Spec 4 says transit to human driving mode when receive human steering cmd, brake pressed, in (auto final). The model triggers the return from AutonomousActive, not from the autonomous final state.
issues.where: AutonomousActive --> HumanDriving : Human Steering Cmd and AutonomousActive --> HumanDriving : Brake Pressed

issues.issue: Unspecified Front Distance <= 10 transition into AutonomousIdle
issues.reason: Spec only defines front_distance > 10 as causing a move to autonomous. The model adds an explicit Front Distance <=10 transition from Autonomous to AutonomousIdle which is not specified.

issues.issue: AutonomousFinal is not modeled as a sub-state of the Autonomous sub-machine
issues.reason: Spec 2 says autonomous mode has sub-states and is represented by a sub machine state. AutonomousFinal is defined as a top-level state outside Autonomous, so the autonomous hierarchy is incomplete and the ‘auto final’ referenced in spec 4 is not represented inside the sub-machine.
issues.where: AutonomousFinal : Auto Final State and HumanDriving --> AutonomousFinal : Power Off

issues.issue: Initial start lacks the required Power On trigger
issues.reason: Spec 3 requires the system to turn into human driving mode when power on. The model’s initial transition to HumanDriving is unlabeled, so the power-on condition is not represented on the entry to human driving.

system_prompt:
You are an experienced control-systems engineer reviewing a state machine model against the natural-language specification it was built from.

You are given two things, both complete and unmodified:
  1. The natural-language specification.
  2. A state machine model written in PlantUML.

Your task: identify the places where the model does not conform to the specification. Read the specification in full first, then read the model in full, then report what you find.

Report as many or as few issues as you actually find, and organize them however you judge best. For each issue, state what the non-conformance is, which part of the model it concerns, and why you consider it a non-conformance.

Write your findings in en-US. Return only the requested structured response.
user_prompt:
## Natural-language specification

1 The human driving mode is represented by a simple state. 2 The autonomous mode has sub-states and is represented by a sub machine state. 3. when power on, the system turn into human driving mode 4when front_distance > 10, auto transport to autonomous state 4. transit to human driving mode when receive human steering cmd, brake pressed, in (auto final) 5 when power off, it will transit to final state

## State machine model (PlantUML)

@startuml
[*] --> HumanDriving
HumanDriving : Human Driving Mode

HumanDriving --> Autonomous : Power On
Autonomous : Autonomous Mode
Autonomous : <<submachine>>

Autonomous --> AutonomousIdle : Front Distance <= 10
AutonomousIdle : Autonomous Idle Mode

AutonomousIdle --> AutonomousActive : Front Distance > 10
AutonomousActive : Autonomous Active Mode

AutonomousActive --> HumanDriving : Human Steering Cmd
AutonomousActive --> HumanDriving : Brake Pressed

HumanDriving --> Autonomous : Front Distance > 10
HumanDriving --> AutonomousFinal : Power Off

AutonomousFinal : Auto Final State
@enduml
